WELCOME

Welcome, we’re excited to see you soon!

Everything you need to prepare, travel, and arrive ready is gathered here in one focused guide, making the weeks before the Institute feel clear, organized, and manageable.

Welcome to the 2026 Healthcare HR Management Institute, and thank you for choosing to join us. We are delighted to bring together an exceptional group of senior Healthcare HR leaders and solution providers for three days of meaningful conversations, fresh perspectives, and valuable relationship-building opportunities.

In the coming weeks, we will guide you through three simple steps to help prepare for a successful program. Your Operations Lead, Katrina Brightling, will be available throughout the process to provide support and ensure you are ready to make the most of your experience.

YOUR OPERATIONS LEAD

Katrina Brightling

Operations Director

IPMI

BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

Preparing for your Institute is as easy as 1-2-3.

Complete these actions in the Attendee Hub, then build a schedule around the conversations that matter most to you.

Submit Your Travel Details

Please submit your Travel Details through the “Book Hotel” tab of your Attendee Hub to make your hotel reservation for the event.

Create Your Attendee Profile

Prior to the event, please complete the brief questionnaire addressing your specific operational goals and strategic objectives for the program.

Create Your Itinerary

Customize your event agenda by selecting your conference sessions, Think Tanks, and business meeting preferences for the Institute.

YOUR DIGITAL HOME BASE

Attendee Hub.

The Attendee Hub is your central resource for all event-related information. Through the Hub, you can review key dates and deliverables, submit your Attendee Profile questionnaire and hotel requirements, build your personalized itinerary, and access important event information and resources.

Attendee Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks before the event start date.

OPEN ATTENDEE HUB

ARRIVE WITH CONFIDENCE

Hotel & Travel.

The essentials for your stay at Grande Lakes, from room coverage to local transportation.

The Ritz-Carlton, Orlando, FL
4012 Central Florida Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32837, United States
Hotel Reservations

Secure your reservation by submitting your hotel needs through the Attendee Hub’s “Book Hotel” tab by the deadline. Your participation includes two nights; additional nights, if available, are $335 per night plus a $25 nightly resort fee, payable at check-out.

REQUEST RESERVATION SUPPORT
Transportation

Guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the hotel. For destination information and helpful local recommendations, please visit the Attendee Hub.

DESIGNED AROUND CONNECTION

Your Institute Experience.

A purposeful mix of insight, one-to-one conversation, and peer collaboration.

Thought Leadership Sessions

Gain valuable insights from industry leaders through panel discussions and case studies focused on the most pressing issues facing healthcare HR executives.

Business Meetings

Connect one-on-one with leading Service Providers in curated 30-minute meetings tailored to your interests, priorities, and business objectives.

Interactive Think Tank Sessions

Collaborate with peers in small-group discussions designed to tackle shared challenges, exchange ideas, and develop actionable strategies in a highly engaging, solution-focused environment.

HELPFUL ANSWERS

Frequently Asked Questions.
?
What are my participation requirements?

You are required to complete the following three tasks prior to the event: 1) Complete Your Attendee Profile; 2) Submit Hotel Reservation/Travel Details; and 3) Create Your Itinerary.
